name: Retained Physical Credentials
description: Cloned RFID credentials and physically duplicated keys allow re-entry to the target facility without requiring a new social engineering or bypass approach. A cloned credential can be used by any operator with the appropriate emulation device, extending the team's access capability across the full engagement window. Key bitting captured via a Lishi tool can be used to produce a functional duplicate key that provides silent, repeatable re-entry.

blue.det: Cloned credential used after engagement; anti-passback violation; access at unusual time or location post-engagement.
blue.cm: Credential rotation after suspected compromise; anti-passback and geofencing; time-limited credentials for contractors and visitors; monitor for access outside normal patterns.
